reason: The full batch review found batch-local scope, hypothesis and domain clarifications that need repair before acceptance.

findings.reason: The Definition says the reaction is not determined by a constrained curve until ideality is imposed, but its equation gives R=Mx''-F for any specified curve and model force; distinguish determining R for a given curve from selecting admissible dynamics.
Tong §2.3.2 Eq. (2.41) supports the specific rolling coin on a slope, not an unqualified claim about general 3D rolling; identify that model or supply the broader local nonintegrability argument.
In proof step 1.2, evaluating tau(t,0,ydot) only at basis vectors does not isolate omega cross e_j from the constant translational term; first evaluate at ydot=0 and subtract.

Fact F5 applies def-cm06-nonholonomic-model's 3N-dimensional domain to q=(x,theta) in R^2; state the reduced-coordinate criterion locally or supply an n=2 supplier, although step 1.1 proves this special case.
The Statement defines Lambda and a using F although F is defined only on I0×Q×(R3)^N; specify O'=O∩(I0×Q) as their domain and as the first-order system's domain.

The remark's claim that the two prescriptions produce different motions from the same data is stronger than the cited counterexample's explicit result that the displayed d'Alembert motion is not vakonomic; state the set distinction precisely or establish the stronger existence claim.

The Statement uses lambda from multiplier-balance clause 1, whose hypotheses require G in C3 with rank on all O and F in C1, but lists only C2 and rank on Sigma; carry those conditions or justify the stated broader scope directly.
The force map omits its velocity argument, and v0 denotes both the scalar radial speed and the vector (v0,Omega r0,0); state the full force-map type and use distinct symbols.
The force map omits its velocity argument, and step 4.1 uses positivity on |theta|≤pi/3 without deriving from E=-5 J that the motion from the stated initial data remains on that arc.
Assign dimensions to the general parameters a0, vc, omega0, beta and gamma; the explicit numerical choices do not define the dimensions of the parameters used in the chart.
